item.tib: gu ru drag po'i tshogs skang rin chen phreng ba
item.coloph: slob dpon pad+ma'i thugs bcud sdus / stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyis / phyi rabs las ldan gshen la brgyud pa dge legs 'phel bar shog …

item.tib: gu ru drag po'i tshogs bskangs rin chen phreng ba
item.coloph: rig 'dzin drag po'i cha lag las/ tshogs mchod rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba/ dben pa'i gnas su rdo rje rtsal gyis sbyar/ 'gal ba bshags cing dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo//
